name: Queen Merneith
source: The young Queen of Zeta. She has not been in power for long yet, a couple of years now, but, as is to be expected, her role puts her at the centre of the religious beliefs of Zetans who pray her name. She is in good standing with her subjects, who adore her as most Zetans are taught to do.
translation: The young Queen of Zeta. She has not been in power for long yet, a couple of years now, but, as is to be expected, her role puts her at the centre of the religious beliefs of Zetans who pray her name. She is in good standing with her subjects, who adore her as most Zetans are taught to do.
